note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this book was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the 1962-register Old Testament renderings the first translation carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19), so the unmarked Matt 7:13, Matt 19:21, Ps 1:6 and James 1:5 in chapters 7-8 take OWB's words too. `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`: allusions in Bernard's prose, his own paraphrases, the three Ecclesiasticus quotations (not in OWB), and Vulgate readings his argument rests on that OWB does not have.

Judgement calls: Bernard quotes the Vulgate, and where OWB still carries his point it is quoted as it stands — Ps 37:18 'keeps' (which suits his 'He keeps us' better than the Vulgate's 'knoweth'), Ps 73:28 'draw near' for 'adhere', Ps 77:2 «ማጽናኛም አልተቀበልኩም» for 'my soul refused to be comforted', Ps 17:15, Ps 88:13 (prayer 'arrives first'), Eccl 5:10, Ps 145:7 («ትዝታ», memory), Ps 68:16, Isa 38:14 and Ps 120:5 (joined pieces). Ps 62:11 keeps OWB's ብርታት / ጽኑ ፍቅር while Bernard's next lines keep 'power and mercy' (ኃይል / ምሕረት). The love commandment of 10.3 (heart, soul, strength) is Deut 6:5. John 14:26's Paraclete is OWB's ጠበቃ (decision 'comforter'; Bernard does not argue from the word). Matt 6:10 is OWB «ፈቃድህ በምድርም ይደረግ» (decision 'thy-will-be-done'). Psalm 36:4 and 145:16 are framed in the prose ('as it is said …') because OWB words them in another person. Kept as self_rendered because OWB cannot carry Bernard's argument: Ps 16:2, Song 1:8, Song 2:5, Ps 28:7, Gen 27:27, Ps 49:18, Ps 76:2, Ps 116:15, Song 5:1 (eat / drink / be inebriated) and Ps 23:5.
